title: Micromouse hosts its first workshop
content: Thank you SO MUCH for such a warm welcome at our very first meeting!! Look out for more upcoming workshops + a post on competition logistics/resources. We covered robot chassis design, sensor selection, and microcontrollers for autonomous navigation. Slides and resources are now available on our Discord server!

title: Welcome to McMaster Micromouse 2026-2027
content: We're thrilled to kick off an exciting new year of Micromouse! Whether you're in first year or graduating, in electrical, software, mechatronics, or mechanical engineering, there's a place for you on our teams. Stay tuned for our workshop schedule, club showcase booth, and competition announcements.
